scenario.title: A claim from a voice walk-through, with no saved inventory
scenario.user: I had a flood on June 20, 2026 around 2 am in the basement. I recorded a voice note walking through it yesterday. Prepare my contents claim.

answers.answer: The assistant is on the local model. Go on.
The walk-through from June 21, the newest one.
No need to build a list from all my photos. Use what I said in the voice note.

No. The armchair in the living room is a different chair. The one I lost was in the basement and I have no photo of it. The undated coffee table photo: I do not know when it was taken, so do not count it. The floor lamp and the mini-fridge were lost too. The side tables and the monitor arm were not lost. The TV is worth 700 CAD and the gaming chair 300 CAD. The coffee table was lost. Everything else is right, and I have nothing to add.

answers.answer: English. No insurer name or claim number. No camera covers the basement. Use the voice note. The loss was at 02:00 on 2026-06-20, water, basement only.

answers.match: confirm|which of these|were lost|correct|anything to (add|change)|replacement value|rows?
answers.answer: The armchair in the living room is a different chair: the one I lost was in the basement and I have no photo of it. I do not know when the undated coffee table photo was taken, so do not count it. The floor lamp and the mini-fridge were lost too. The side tables and the monitor arm were not lost. The coffee table was lost. The TV is worth 700 CAD and the gaming chair 300 CAD. Everything else is right. Yes, the receipts belong to those items.
